name: International football results (1872-present)
coverage: 50,119 men's full internationals, 1872-11-30 to 2026-11-17; plus shootouts.csv and goalscorers.csv
note: Updated continuously (last push 2026-11-18). Excludes Olympic, B-team and U-23 matches; uses current team names.

name: football-data.co.uk results and betting odds
coverage: Up to 22 European divisions back to 1993/94; match stats and bookmaker odds from 2000/01; extra leagues (e.g. Brazil, Japan, MLS)
note: 2026/27 files add HxG/AxG expected-goals columns alongside opening and closing odds. Column codes in notes.txt.

name: Club Elo ratings API
coverage: Daily Elo ratings for European clubs; history by club or by date
note: On 2026-11-19 date/club endpoints returned HTTP 502 repeatedly; /Fixtures reports 'Fixtures API deactivated'. Website itself loads.

name: openfootball football.json
coverage: Fixtures and results for major European and other leagues, 2010/11 to 2026/27 (292 JSON files)
note: Current season auto-built daily from Football.TXT sources; no API key needed (raw GitHub URLs).

name: engsoccerdata
coverage: English league results from 1888 plus FA Cup, playoffs, non-league and other European leagues; title says 1871-2026
note: Licence taken from package DESCRIPTION; repo has no LICENSE file. Last push 2026-02-08.

name: footballcsv
coverage: League results for England, Spain, Germany, Austria, MLS, Champions League and more
note: Many repos untouched since 2020; England repo last pushed 2023.

name: schochastics football-data
coverage: 1,237,935 games in 207 top-tier domestic leagues and international tournaments, 1888-2023
note: README warns of errors in older games where sources are less reliable.

name: Fjelstul World Cup Database
coverage: All 22 men's World Cups (1930-2022) and 9 women's (1991-2019); 27 tables incl. goals, bookings, squads
note: Newer version on WorldCups.ai offered under CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial).

name: Fjelstul English Football Database
coverage: Premier League and EFL matches, appearances and standings, 1888-2024
note: Last push 2024-05; requires named attribution per README.

name: English Women's Football (EWF) Database
coverage: Women's Super League since 2011 and second tier since 2014: matches, appearances, standings
note: Actively updated (last push 2026-10-28).

name: OpenLigaDB
coverage: Bundesliga and other community-maintained leagues; e.g. 306 Bundesliga 2025/26 fixtures via API
note: No authentication required; results entered by registered users. Year is earliest web-archive capture.

name: European Soccer Database (Kaggle)
coverage: 25,000+ matches, 10,000+ players, 11 European top leagues, 2008-2016; FIFA attributes and odds
license: Database: Open Database, Contents: © Original Authors
note: Author asks for no commercial use; Kaggle login needed to download. Not updated since 2016.

name: FiveThirtyEight SPI ratings
coverage: Club match-by-match SPI ratings and forecasts from 2016; international SPI
note: Documented CSV URL now returns an HTML page, not data; only the README remains in the repo.

name: World Football Elo Ratings
coverage: Elo ratings for men's national teams, full history
note: TSV endpoints are what the site's JavaScript loads; not a documented API.

name: Beat The Bookie odds series
coverage: 479,440 games (818 leagues, 2005-2015) closing odds; 92,647 games hourly odds series (2015-2016)
note: Odds from up to 32 bookmakers, scraped from odds portals; accompanies 'Beating the bookies with their own numbers'.

name: EA Sports FC 24 complete player dataset
coverage: Career Mode player, coach and team ratings, FIFA 15 to EA Sports FC 24
note: Video-game ratings scraped from sofifa; CC0 label is the uploader's and may not cover EA's rights.

name: Fantasy Premier League historical data
coverage: FPL player prices, points and gameweek stats from 2016/17 to 2026/27
note: MIT covers the code; data comes from the unofficial FPL API (download_url), whose terms belong to the Premier League.

name: American Soccer Analysis API
coverage: MLS, NWSL, USL and other US leagues: xG, xPass, goals added (g+) by player, team, game
note: Year is the itscalledsoccer client repo creation; no licence stated for the data.

name: transfermarkt-datasets
coverage: 12 tables: 88,000+ games, 50,000+ players, 650,000+ valuations, 175,000+ transfers; incl. WC 2026 group stage
note: Updates paused: data current to 6 July 2026. Per-table CSVs at the same R2 bucket, e.g. /data/players.csv.gz.

name: Deloitte Football Money League
coverage: Annual revenue ranking of the highest-earning clubs; 2026 edition is current
note: A report, not downloadable data; figures must be transcribed manually.

name: Capology football salaries
coverage: Estimated player wages and payrolls for major leagues, current season
note: Not open data; site blocked automated fetch (HTTP 403). Year is earliest archived salary page.

name: StatsBomb Open Data (event data)
coverage: 80 competition-seasons, 3,961 matches (1958-2025), men's and women's; e.g. full PL/Serie A 15/16, Messi La Liga, World Cups
note: Repo now redirects to hudl/open-data. Must credit StatsBomb with its logo; no redistribution or commercial use.

name: StatsBomb 360 freeze frames (open subset)
note: Use match_available_360 in competitions.json; match_updated_360 holds 2021 placeholder dates for seasons without 360.

name: Hudl StatsBomb J1 League 2024 free data
coverage: Japan J1 League 2024: event data (xG, OBV, pressures) plus Hudl physical aggregates (14 metrics)
note: Separate from the GitHub repo; gated by a web form, no licence shown on page.

name: Wyscout soccer match event dataset (Pappalardo et al.)
provider: Wyscout / Pappalardo et al., Scientific Data 2019
coverage: 1,941 matches: 2017/18 Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, World Cup 2018, Euro 2016
note: Paper DOI 10.1038/s41597-019-0247-7. Figshare HTML returned 202 bot check; verified via figshare API and download.

name: Impect Open Data
coverage: Full Bundesliga 2023/24 season (306 matches): events, event-level KPIs (e.g. bypassed opponents), lineups, player KPIs
note: Terms forbid redistribution and commercial use; credit Impect with logo. Loader in kloppy >= 3.18.

name: Afriskaut Dynasty Scouting League 2024
coverage: 136 matches of the Dynasty Scouting League 2024: events, lineups, metadata
note: Rare open event data from an African competition; proprietary Afriskaut event schema with PDF definitions.

name: Metrica Sports sample data
coverage: 3 anonymised matches (no team/player names) with synchronised tracking and event data
format: Games 1-2: CSV (per-team tracking + events); Game 3: EPTS FIFA TXT + XML metadata, JSON events
note: 25 Hz, coordinates normalised 0-1 on a 105x68 m pitch. No LICENSE file; README asks to acknowledge the source.

name: SkillCorner Open Data
coverage: 20 Australian A-League 2024/25 matches (README still says 10): tracking, dynamic events, phases of play; season aggregates
format: JSONL tracking (Git LFS), CSV events/phases, JSON match
note: 10 fps, metres, origin at pitch centre. Original 2020 European matches replaced Oct 2025; 10 more added Sep 2026.

name: SkillCorner Open Data - Body Pose
coverage: 3D body pose (29 joints per player) for 2 A-League 2024/25 matches (1925299, 1996435)
note: 25 fps, detected players only; added September 2026. One phase sample kept in the GitHub repo.

name: PFF FC FIFA World Cup 2022 data
coverage: All 64 matches of the 2022 men's World Cup: broadcast tracking, events, player grades, rosters
format: JSONL.bz2 tracking per game, JSON events, CSV metadata
note: Access via web form; restructured Feb 2025. No licence stated on page. Loader in kloppy.

name: IDSSE: integrated spatiotemporal and event data (Bassek et al.)
provider: DFL / Sportec Solutions / German Sport University Cologne
coverage: 7 matches, Bundesliga and 2. Bundesliga 2022/23: positions of all players and ball, events, match info
note: Scientific Data 12:195 (2025). 25 Hz TRACAB optical tracking. Mirror at huggingface.co/datasets/pysport/idsse-data; kloppy sportec loader.

name: Last Row tracking data
provider: Ricardo Tavares (Last Row) / Friends of Tracking
coverage: 19 Liverpool FC goals from 2019 plus two other sequences; players near the ball and ball
note: 20 fps, hand-collected from video; README says it lacks research-grade accuracy. No LICENSE; credit requested.

name: SoccerTrack (v1)
coverage: 8K fisheye and 4K drone videos with player/ball bounding boxes and GNSS (10 Hz) positions
note: Hosted on Kaggle (login to download). Original GitHub repo now redirects to SportsLabKit.

name: SoccerTrack v2
coverage: 10 full university matches, 932 min of fixed 4K panoramic video; per-frame pitch coordinates, IDs, 12-class ball actions
note: Hugging Face access requires accepting terms (auto-approved). arXiv 2508.01802; used for SoccerTrack Challenge 2025.

name: TeamTrack
coverage: 150+ min of high-resolution full-pitch video for soccer, basketball and handball with MOT labels
note: Multi-sport; Hugging Face mirror returned 401. Code at github.com/AtomScott/TeamTrack.

name: SoccerMon
provider: Simula / Midoglu et al., Scientific Data 2024
coverage: 2 Norwegian women's elite teams, 2020-2021: 10,075 GPS sessions from 76 players (STATSports APEX)
note: 10 Hz GNSS plus accelerometer/gyroscope-derived metrics. Old OSF link (osf.io/uryz9) returns HTTP 410; Zenodo is current.

name: SoccerMon subjective reports (wellness, load, injury)
provider: Simula / Midoglu et al., Scientific Data 2024
coverage: 33,849 self-reports from 50 players, 2020-2021: 17,002 wellness, training load/RPE, 306 injury, 32 illness
size: 0.7 MB zip (~9.3 MB unzipped per paper)
note: Same Zenodo record as SoccerMon GPS; anonymised player IDs shared across subjective and GPS files.

name: Alfheim soccer video and player position dataset
coverage: 3 Tromsø IL home matches (2013) at Alfheim stadium: ZXY radio tracking plus panoramic video
note: ZXY wearable sensors at 20 Hz. Could not verify: datasets.simula.no failed TLS certificate check on 2026-11-19.

name: 3D Shot Posture Dataset (AutoSoccerPose)
coverage: 210 shot clips from SoccerNet broadcasts (200 train with 2D/3D keypoints, 10 test), 20 frames each
note: Derived from SoccerNet video; check SoccerNet terms for the underlying footage.

name: WorldPose
coverage: 80+ sequences from FIFA World Cup 2022, ~2.5 million 3D poses (SMPL), camera parameters
note: Research-only data request form; FIFA-owned video needs a separate agreement. arXiv 2501.02771.

name: SoccerNet-v2 action spotting (labels, features, videos)
coverage: 500 broadcast games (+50 challenge), 5 European leagues + UCL, 2014/15-2016/17; ~300k annotations, 17 action classes
format: JSON labels, NumPy features, MKV video (224p/720p)
license: Labels: none stated; SN-Features: 'other'; videos: SoccerNet NDA
note: Labels and features public on Hugging Face; videos (SoccerNet_raw_HQ) gated behind NDA. Old password downloads deprecated.

name: SoccerNet Ball Action Spotting
coverage: Ball-action labels (pass, drive, etc.) on full games; 7+2 games in 2023, extended in 2024-2025 editions
note: NDA-gated on Hugging Face; ZIPs are password-free once access is granted.

name: SoccerNet Camera Calibration 2023
coverage: Broadcast frames with annotated pitch line segments for camera calibration
note: Public on Hugging Face; no licence tag on the dataset card. Code repo has no licence.

name: SoccerNet Tracking 2023
coverage: 30-second main-camera clips with tracklets for players, referees and ball (MOT format)
note: Public on Hugging Face; raw tracking video is a separate gated repo.

name: SoccerNet Re-Identification 2023
coverage: Player crops from action and replay frames with cross-view identity labels
note: Public; code repo (sn-reid) is MIT.

name: SoccerNet Jersey Number Recognition 2023
coverage: Player tracklets with jersey-number labels
note: Public on Hugging Face; no licence tag.

name: SoccerNet Game State Reconstruction (GSR)
coverage: 200 annotated 30 s broadcast clips: pitch positions, roles, teams, jersey numbers (minimap)
note: Public. Baseline in sn-gamestate (TrackLab). arXiv 2404.11335.

name: SoccerNet MVFouls
coverage: Multi-view clips of fouls with type and severity (card) labels
note: Marked public in SoccerNet README (2024 and 2025 editions).

name: SoccerNet Monocular Depth
coverage: Synthetic football (and basketball) frames with depth maps
note: Public; synthetic game-engine footage, not real broadcasts.

name: SoccerNet Player-Centric Ball Action Spotting 2026 (FOOTPASS)
coverage: Full broadcast matches with play-by-play actions linked to players, plus tracking/identification inputs
note: NDA-gated. Paper arXiv 2511.16183; baselines at github.com/JeremieOchin/FOOTPASS.

name: SoccerReplay-1988
coverage: 1,988 full matches with automatically generated event and commentary annotations
note: Non-commercial NDA form required before Hugging Face access. arXiv 2412.01820 (UniSoccer).

name: SportsMOT
coverage: 240 clips (basketball, football, volleyball), 720p 25 fps; football clips avg ~674 frames
note: Download via Codalab competition sign-up; use conditional on competition terms.

name: Roboflow football-players-detection
coverage: Annotated broadcast frames: player, goalkeeper, referee, ball; sibling ball and pitch-keypoint sets
license: CC BY 4.0 (per Universe listings; original page not fetched)
note: Universe returned Cloudflare 403 to scripts. Companion code github.com/roboflow/sports is MIT.

name: DFL Bundesliga Data Shootout
coverage: Bundesliga match video with annotated events (play, throw-in, challenge) for event detection
note: Competition data; reuse limited by competition rules. Kaggle account needed.

name: SoccerNet-Caption
coverage: ~37k timestamped commentaries over 715.9 h of SoccerNet broadcast games
license: Labels: none stated; videos: SoccerNet NDA
note: Dense video captioning task; captions public, matching video requires NDA. arXiv 2304.04565.

name: SoccerNet-Echoes
coverage: Whisper ASR transcripts (v1/v2/v3) and English translations of SoccerNet game commentary
note: Machine transcriptions, not human-verified. arXiv 2405.07354; repo github.com/SoccerNet/sn-echoes.

name: GOAL (knowledge-grounded commentary)
coverage: 8.9k soccer clips, 22k commentary sentences, 42k knowledge triples
note: Annotations via Tsinghua cloud links; videos must come from SoccerNet. arXiv 2303.14655.

name: MatchTime / SN-Caption-test-align
coverage: Re-aligned SoccerNet-Caption commentary; 49 manually timestamp-aligned test matches
note: Also on Google Drive per repo; videos from SoccerNet (NDA). arXiv 2406.18530.

name: SoccerBench / SoccerNet VQA 2026
provider: Rao et al. (SoccerAgent, ACM MM 2025) / SoccerNet
coverage: ~10k multimodal multiple-choice QA pairs over 14 soccer tasks (text, image, video)
note: LLM/VLM benchmark; challenge split at huggingface.co/datasets/SoccerNet/SN-VQA-2026.

name: Google Research Football (gfootball)
coverage: 11v11 football RL environment with academy scenarios
note: Based on Gameplay Football engine. Last push 2025-06; used in 2020 Kaggle competition.

name: rSoccer
coverage: Gym environments for RoboCup SSL and Very Small Size robot soccer
note: Robot soccer, not human football; last push 2026-02.

name: dm_control locomotion soccer
coverage: MuJoCo multi-agent soccer with boxhead and humanoid players
note: Physics-based continuous control; actively maintained (push 2026-11).

name: Unity ML-Agents SoccerTwos
coverage: 2v2 soccer example environment in the ML-Agents toolkit
note: Year is toolkit release; SoccerTwos is one bundled example environment.

name: RoboCup Soccer Simulator (rcssserver)
coverage: 2D multi-agent 11v11 soccer simulation server
note: Server for RoboCup 2D Simulation League; still maintained (push 2026-11-17).
